prompt: A table shows $x: 0, 1, 2$ and $y: 7, 10, 13$. What is $b$, the starting value of the line?

hints.text: Look at the first column of the table: $x = 0$ pairs with which $y$?

explanation: So $b = 7$. (The jump of $+3$ each step is $m$, but that is not what was asked.)

alternativeExplanations.title: On the graph
steps: The point on the $y$-axis is $(0, 7)$ — the line starts at height $7$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Walk the pattern backward
steps: Step back from $x = 1$: $10 - 3 = 7$ at $x = 0$ — the start is $7$.
